gmail.create_draft.description: Create a draft in the mailbox. Does not send.
gmail.create_draft.rationale: The draft stays inside the account until a human sends or approves it.

gmail.forward.description: Forward a message to a new recipient.
gmail.forward.rationale: Moves content to a new audience: human approval required.

gmail.reply.description: Reply to a thread. Sends immediately in the underlying API.
gmail.reply.rationale: A reply is a send wearing a friendlier name. Tier follows effect, not the label.

gmail.search.description: Search the mailbox and return matching messages.

gmail.send_message.description: Send an email to a recipient outside the system.
gmail.send_message.rationale: Irreversible and visible to another person: human approval required, every time.

gmail.update_draft.description: Edit an existing draft. Does not send.
